full_judgment:
Bimalendu Bikash Roy Chowdhury. J.- This petition is by the accused petitioner for leave to appeal from the judgment and order dated 13 May 1988 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division Discharging the Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3974 of 1997. It is however out of time by 4 days. For the explanation offered by the petitioner the delay is condoned. 

 3. On perusal of the said report a Special Tribunal of Satkhira, by its order dated 28 October 1996, took cognizance of the offence under Section 4(b) of the Cruelty to Women (Deterrent Punishment) Ordinance, 1983 against the petitioner and two others, which gave rise to Special Tribunal Case No. 245 of 1995. 

 4. Being aggrieved the petitioner moved the High Court Division with an application under Section 561-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3974 of 1997, for quashment of the proceeding. 

 5. It was urged before the High Court Division that victim girl was major and gave birth to a child after her marriage with the petitioner and the report of the Medical Board regarding her age was not conclusive evidence. Therefore the Special Tribunal should not have taken cognizance in the case. 

 9. The age of a victim is not a material consideration for an offence under Section 4(b) of the Cruelty to Women (Deterrent Punishment) Ordinance, 1983, although the prosecution case and the doctor's report are that the age of the victim would not exceed 15 years. We therefore find no substance in the petition which is accordingly dismissed.
